title: Localization of cohomology of a derived tensor
statement: Let R\to A and R\to R' be ring maps, put A'=A\otimes_R R', and let M be a complex of A-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. For a prime q' of A' with images q in A, p' in R' and p in R, there is a natural isomorphism H^i(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L} R')\otimes_{A'}A'_{q'} \cong H^i(M_q\otimes_{R_p}^{\mathbf L} R'_{p'})\otimes_{A_q\otimes_{R_p}R'_{p'}}A'_{q'} for every i, where the A-action on the left is induced by endomorphisms of M in D(A) and the right side uses the localized complex. The isomorphism is compatible with morphisms of M and with the canonical comparison map to M\otimes_A^{\mathbf L} A'.
